newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Liverpool opens $15 mln store.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Liverpool opens $15 mln store.

text.p: Retail chain El Puerto de Liverpool opened a new $15 million department store in Leon, the firm reported on Wednesday.
"Our aim is to make Liverpool the best store of its kind in the region," said local manager Manuel Berrospe.
The new store had a sales floorspace of 113,000 square feet and would create 300 direct jobs, and another 1,000 indirectly, Berrospe added.
Liverpool has seven stores in Mexico City and one each in the northern industrial city of Monterrey, and in the Gulf of Mexico cities of Villahermosa and Tampico, the company said.
